name: LinkedIn Learning Group Buy
shortDescription: Explore LinkedIn Learning courses for business, tech and creative skills. Check course availability, progress tracking and certificates before ordering.
description:
LinkedIn Learning Group Buy is an option to compare if you want to learn Excel, web development, project management, or design through online video courses. Start with a task you want to do better, such as building a budget sheet or planning your first client project. Then choose a course at your level that teaches that task.

Find a course you can put to use

Check the lesson list, course level, language and software version. A short course can help you learn one skill, while a learning path can guide you through several related topics. If you want to practise along with the instructor, check whether your course includes exercise files and whether those files are available with this offer.

What should you check before ordering?

  • Course access: Send the course name or link and confirm it is included.
  • Access period: Check when your access starts, when it ends, and what renewal costs.
  • Progress: Ask whether you can resume a lesson and keep your course history.
  • Devices: Confirm whether access works in your browser and on the device you use to study.
  • Certificates: Ask if the specific course offers one and whether it can be issued in your name.

LinkedIn Learning certificates and profile sharing

Eligible LinkedIn Learning courses and learning paths can award a certificate of completion. If your employer or client needs proof of training, confirm the exact credential they accept. Ask whether this offer lets you download a certificate in your own name or add it to your personal LinkedIn profile.

Frequently asked questions

Is LinkedIn Premium included?

LinkedIn Premium bundles learning with other LinkedIn features. Check the SEOGBTools offer for the specific access included before ordering.

Can I learn on my phone?

Confirm supported devices and whether access works through a mobile browser or the LinkedIn Learning app.

What happens when access ends?

Ask whether your progress, course history and certificates remain available, and whether renewal continues the same access.

Compare other online learning options

Check the same topic on Udemy Pro and Coursera Plus. Compare the syllabus, practice tasks and certificate requirements before choosing.
